analyst.summary: Va Tech Wabag is a debt-free water-treatment EPC and operations company serving municipal and industrial clients in India and abroad. It has delivered consistent profit growth (20-30% year-on-year in every recent quarter) and keeps winning new orders, most recently a Bangalore water-and-sewerage contract. The main watch-items are historically low promoter holding and slow-paying government clients (high receivables), both structural features of this business rather than fresh red flags. We rate it a Hold.
